description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for four different conditions – mBERT-targ, XLM-targ, mBERT-permute, and XLM-permute – across eight language families. The horizontal axis represents the language family categories, labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, and “Semitic”, “Uralic”, presented in an unspecified order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10. For each language family, there are four bars grouped together. The “mBERT-targ” bars are light blue, the “XLM-targ” bars are dark blue, the “mBERT-permute” bars are light green, and the “XLM-permute” bars are dark green. Within each language family, the bars generally show similar heights, with error bars extending above and below each bar. The “Isolate” language family shows the tallest bars, with “XLM-targ” reaching approximately 32 and “XLM-permute” reaching approximately 30. The “Uralic” language family shows the shortest bars, with “XLM-permute” reaching approximately 2 and “mBERT-targ” reaching approximately 3. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
